stemMd:
A researcher claims that shaded plots retained a larger fraction of their initial soil moisture than exposed plots did after six days.

| Plot | Initial moisture (%) | Day 6 moisture (%) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Shaded 1 | 30 | 24 |
| Shaded 2 | 25 | 20 |
| Exposed 1 | 32 | 16 |
| Exposed 2 | 28 | 14 |

Which choice best uses the table to support the claim?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Both shaded plots retained 80 percent of their initial moisture, whereas both exposed plots retained 50 percent.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The exposed plots had no moisture after six days.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Shaded plots had higher initial moisture than every exposed plot.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every plot lost the same number of percentage points.

explanationMd: Compare final with initial within each plot: 24/30=20/25=0.8, while 16/32=14/28=0.5. Fractions retained support the stated comparison better than raw final values alone.

distractorRationale.b: Their final values are 16 and 14 percent.
distractorRationale.c: The initial values do not support this ordering.
